invariants.text: A customer can search their orders and invoices by customer_id or by order status.
A product must belong to a valid category, as defined by the category_id in the product record.
A product's stock quantity must not go below zero after any reservation or release operation.
An administrator can add, update, or delete products and categories, but only if the product's stock quantity is zero or the category exists and is valid.
An order cannot be cancelled if it is not in the confirmed status.
An order cannot be confirmed if it is already confirmed or cancelled.
Cancelling a confirmed order releases the reserved stock for each product in the order by subtracting the quantity from the reserved amount.
Category.category_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Confirming an order reserves the stock quantity of each product in the order by the quantity specified in the order item.
Customer.customer_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Invoice.invoice_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Invoice.order_id must reference an existing Order.order_id
Order.customer_id must reference an existing Customer.customer_id
Order.order_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
OrderItem.order_id must reference an existing Order.order_id
OrderItem.order_item_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
OrderItem.product_id must reference an existing Product.product_id
Product.category_id must reference an existing Category.category_id
Product.product_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
The total amount in an invoice must match the sum of (unit_price * quantity) for all order items in the corresponding order.
When an order is confirmed, an invoice must be created with a total amount equal to the sum of the unit prices of all products in the order multiplied by their quantities.
